lines.text: The LORD tells Joshua to choose twelve men, one from each tribe, to take twelve stones from the middle of the Jordan.
The twelve men each carry a stone on a shoulder to the camp as a memorial of the Jordan being cut off.
Joshua sets up twelve stones at the town of Adam, and the priests with the ark cross after the people.

wrong_details.true: in the middle of the Jordan

lines.text: About 40,000 armed troops cross before the LORD, and the waters return when the priests step onto dry land, so Israel camps at Shittim.
Joshua sets up the twelve stones at Gilgal, and the Amorite and Canaanite kings lose heart when they hear the Jordan was dried up.
